#melia #danang #resort #resorts #beachresorts #travel #vietnam #explore #adventure #viral #trending #vlog #travelvlog #trend #trendingvideo 

Located alongside the peaceful Non Nuoc Beach, this resort is the ideal destination for those wishing to both relax and explore central Vietnam’s famous attractions, including UNESCO World Heritage’s Hoi An Ancient town and My Son Sanctuary.

Perfect location
Beachfront resort closes to the city, historic attractions, and golf courses

The Level
Enhance your stay in a villa-style accommodation with exclusive extras

Private Beach & Pools
Refresh on the beach or 7 outdoor pools (3 of them for Level guests)

Wellness & Activities
Regain your well-being in the gym, YHI Spa or with activities included

Cape Nao
Try unique Mediterranean cuisine in front of the ocean

MICE and Wedding
Perfect venues to host your events and wedding
